name: Stader NearX
rootCause: Stader NearX on NEAR was exploited on 2022-08-16 after a reentrancy flaw in batch_transaction let gregoshes.near create an unbacked NearX balance and drain about 165,000 NEAR from NearX liquidity pools. A reentrancy flaw in NearX's batch_transaction path let repeated self-transfer and mint logic run before accounting settled, so the contract credited NearX without the matching NEAR stake.
